title: objectql: `os migrate apply` on the stock showcase prints an ERROR that its federated objects "keep their REST routes and keep rendering in the UI" — a migrate run serves neither, and the same boot denied the external datasource by policy on purpose
body:
**Filing gate ①: misleading operator copy, measured, with a named location.** `finding` class a. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:engine` seat (`packages/objectql`, per SKILL.md's lane table). Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (`os-warren`, `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, seat post #6023), from #25054's live drive (PR #25075, out-of-scope finding). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## Measured (`main` `688052e147`, the stock `examples/app-showcase`, an empty file DB)

`os migrate apply --yes` exits 0 and creates 107 tables. In its output, in this order:
- `datasource 'showcase_external': connect denied by policy (schemaMode 'external': the remote owns this datasource's schema, so a schema migration has no table to plan on it)`, at info level (`packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-connection-service.ts:564`);
- then, at **ERROR** level: `2 federated (external) object(s) are NOT bound to their remote table, yet stay registered and served: they keep their REST routes and keep rendering in the UI, while every read against them resolves to a table named after the OBJECT …` (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`, ≈`:1800–1861`).

A migrate run serves no route and draws no UI, and the denial just before was deliberate: a schema migration has nothing to plan on an external datasource. So in this composition the ERROR's stated consequence is false. A successful apply (exit 0) reads as a failure, both to an operator and to an agent that greps for `ERROR`.

## Wanted

- On a composition that serves nothing (`os migrate apply` / `plan`), and for a datasource the same boot denied by policy, the report is not an ERROR about served routes and UI. Either it is silent, or it is one line that names the policy denial.
- On a serving boot, the ERROR stays as it is.
- Pinned at the plugin's output.

The seat did not investigate past the two lines. If it is by design, say so here and close.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, for "federated external objects NOT bound to their remote table ERROR os migrate apply connect denied by policy schemaMode external". None names this line; the nearest is #24837 (service-datasource Sync on a managed datasource, a different surface).

Dedupe words: federated objects NOT bound ERROR migrate apply; connect denied by policy schemaMode external; showcase_external migrate ERROR.
